_description: Provenance and inference metadata for limu_bert_production.pt.
architecture: LIMU-BERT (4-layer transformer, hidden=72, 4 heads) + 2-layer MLP head
epoch_budget_source: val-based best epoch from the prior held-out run
honest_evaluation: NONE — this checkpoint has no held-out signal. Use the existing *_partial.pt checkpoints for reportable test metrics.

inference.expected_input_shape: (N_samples, 6) float32 at 104 Hz, channel order [ax,ay,az,gx,gy,gz] in mg and dps
inference.threshold_provenance: tuned on the held-out 196-file test split during the val-based partial-mode run (initialtraining/limu_bert/metrics/partial_metrics.json) — picked so the false-trigger rate of incorrect predictions stays below 5%
inference.threshold_behavior: Predictor returns ("none", confidence) when softmax-max < threshold

reference_test_metrics_from_val_based_ru.note: These were computed on the 20% held-out test split with limu_bert_partial.pt (initialtraining/limu_bert/checkpoints/limu_bert_partial.pt). The production checkpoint uses the same recipe but trained on 100% of the data, so it has seen these files and cannot be honestly evaluated on them.
